source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 18 (PDF 17-37), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 18 (Transition Metals) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are first row transition elements? Why are they called transition elements?
(Pehli row ke transition elements kya hain? Inhein transition elements kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh d-block ke elements (3d series) hain jin ki kisi bhi stable oxidation state mein d-orbitals adhoore bhare hote hain. Inhein transition elements is liye kehte hain ke yeh mukhtalif oxidation states ke darmiyan tabdeel hote hain.

book_ref.quote: First row transition elements are the elements found in the d block of the Periodic Table

blocks.prompt:
2 On what basis are transition metals divided into d-block and f-block elements?
(Transition metals ko d-block aur f-block mein kis buniyaad par baanta jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electronic configuration ki buniyaad par: agar bahar wale electrons d-orbitals mein bhar rahe hon to d-block, agar f-orbitals mein to f-block. d-block ki pehli row 3d series hai.

book_ref.quote: The transition metals can be classified on the basis of their electronic configuration into d-block

blocks.prompt:
3 Give the old and modern uses of copper, silver and gold mentioned in the chapter.
(Chapter mein di gayi copper, silver aur gold ki purani aur nayi uses batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Qadeem zamane se yeh daulat aur izzat ki alamat rahe aur sikkon aur zevraat mein istemal hue. Aaj yeh apni behtareen corrosion resistance (zang se bachao) aur conductivity ki wajah se electronics aur dentistry mein zaroori hain.

book_ref.quote: Copper, silver and gold are well known since ancient ages as symbols of wealth and prestige.

blocks.prompt:
4 Write the electronic configurations of chromium (Z = 24) and copper (Z = 29). Why do they not follow the Aufbau order?
(Chromium (Z = 24) aur copper (Z = 29) ki electronic configurations likhein. Yeh Aufbau tarteeb par kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Cr: [Ar] 3d⁵4s¹; Cu: [Ar] 3d¹⁰4s¹. Inhein aadhe bhare (3d⁵) aur poore bhare (3d¹⁰) d-subshell ki stability milti hai. Is se electron cloud zyada symmetrical (mutawazin) hota hai aur shielding behtar hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: This stabilizing factor makes the electron cloud of these two elements more symmetrical

blocks.prompt:
5 Write the electronic configurations of Mn (Z = 25), Mn²⁺ and Mn³⁺.
(Mn (Z = 25), Mn²⁺ aur Mn³⁺ ki electronic configurations likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mn: [Ar] 3d⁵4s²; Mn²⁺: [Ar] 3d⁵4s⁰ (dono 4s electrons nikle); Mn³⁺: [Ar] 3d⁴4s⁰ (do 4s aur aik 3d electron nikla).

book_ref.quote: The electronic configuration of first row of transition elements in their neutral (M⁰)

blocks.prompt:
6 Write the configurations of Ni²⁺ (Ni, Z = 28) and Cu²⁺ (Cu, Z = 29) and give the number of 3d electrons in each.
(Ni²⁺ (Ni, Z = 28) aur Cu²⁺ (Cu, Z = 29) ki configurations likhein aur har aik mein 3d electrons ki tadaad batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Ni²⁺: [Ar] 3d⁸4s⁰, 8 d electrons. Cu²⁺: [Ar] 3d⁹4s⁰, 9 d electrons (Table 18.1).

book_ref.quote: Table 18.1 Electronic configurations of first row transition elements

blocks.prompt:
7 How does atomic radius change across the 3d series? Why does it rise a little at the end?
(3d series mein atomic radius kaise badalta hai? Aakhir mein yeh thora kyun barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Atomic radius aam taur par left se right kam hota hai magar aakhir mein thora barhta hai. Yeh izafa copper ke poore bhare d-subshell ki stability se juda hai.

book_ref.quote: This increase may be associated to the stability acquired by copper

blocks.prompt:
8 Why do the densities of transition metals generally increase from titanium to copper?
(Transition metals ki densities titanium se copper tak aam taur par kyun barhti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Row mein nuclear charge baqaida barhta hai aur atomic size sukarta hai. Chhote volume mein zyada mass se density barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: They have high densities that generally increase across the row from titanium to copper.

blocks.prompt:
9 Why are most transition metals and their compounds paramagnetic?
(Aksar transition metals aur un ke compounds paramagnetic kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke un mein un-paired (akele) d electrons hote hain. Aksar 3d metals aur un ke ions ke d-subshells adhoore bhare hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Most of them and their compounds are paramagnetic

blocks.prompt:
10 Differentiate between malleability and ductility of transition metals.
(Transition metals ki malleability aur ductility mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono transition metals ki mechanical khoobiyan hain:

book_ref.quote: They possess a shiny surface, and are malleable

rows: Metal ko hathore se patli chaadar banaya ja sakta hai
Metal ko khench kar taar banaya ja sakta hai
Hathora marne se shakal badalti hai
Khenchne se shakal badalti hai

blocks.prompt:
11 State four physical properties of first row transition metals.
(Pehli row ki transition metals ki chaar physical properties likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Sakht aur mazboot solids; chamakdar chandi jaise ya grey, siwaye surkhi maail bhoore copper ke. (2) Zyada melting aur boiling points. (3) Bijli aur garmi ke ache conductors. (4) Zyada densities; malleable aur ductile.

book_ref.quote: The transition metals exist as hard and rigid solids.

blocks.prompt:
12 List the four chemical properties of transition metals given in the chapter.
(Chapter mein di gayi transition metals ki chaar chemical properties likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Mukhtalif oxidation states, maslan Fe²⁺ aur Fe³⁺. (2) Ligands ke lone pairs khaali d-orbitals mein le kar complexes banana. (3) Roshni jazb karke electron transitions se rangeen ions aur complexes. (4) Catalyst ka kaam, kyun ke oxidation state asaani se badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: They have a high tendency to form coordination compounds (complexes)

blocks.prompt:
13 What oxidation states result when a 3d atom loses (i) only its 4s electrons, (ii) its 4s electrons plus some 3d electrons?
(Jab 3d atom (i) sirf 4s electrons, (ii) 4s ke saath kuch 3d electrons khoye to kaun si oxidation states banti hain?)
blocks.explanation: (i) Sirf 4s electrons khone se aam +2 oxidation state banti hai. (ii) 4s ke saath kuch 3d electrons khone se unchi oxidation states banti hain.

book_ref.quote: The 4s electrons plus a variable number of 3d electrons, giving the higher oxidation states.

blocks.prompt:
14 Calculate the oxidation state of Mn in MnO₄⁻ (O = −2). How is this state reached from the configuration of Mn?
(MnO₄⁻ (O = −2) mein Mn ki oxidation state nikalein. Mn ki configuration se yeh state kaise banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: x + 4(−2) = −1, is liye x = +7. Mn [Ar] 3d⁵4s² hai; dono 4s aur paanchon 3d electrons (7 electrons) khone se +7 banti hai, jo 3d metals mein sab se zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: Among these metals, Mn has the maximum oxidation state of +7.

blocks.prompt:
15 What is meant by the parabolic trend of oxidation states in the 3d series?
(3d series mein oxidation states ke parabolic trend ka kya matlab hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se unchi oxidation state Ti se darmiyan (Mn, +7) tak barhti hai aur phir aakhir (Cu, +1 aur +2) ki taraf ghatti hai. Position ke saath graph qaus (parabola) jaisa banta hai (Table 18.2).

book_ref.quote: The oxidation state of transition elements varies in parabolic trend from left to right within d-block.

blocks.prompt:
16 Distinguish between the homogeneous and heterogeneous catalytic action of transition metals.
(Transition metals ke homogeneous aur heterogeneous catalysis ke amal mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono kam activation energy wala raasta dete hain:

book_ref.quote: This process is generally observed in heterogeneous catalysis.

rows: Metal ion oxidation states badalta hai (maslan Fe²⁺ ⇌ Fe³⁺)
Surface par qabil-e-rasai khaali d-orbitals istemal hote hain
Reactant ke saath unstable intermediate compound banta hai
Reactants surface se jur kar aarzi activated complex banate hain
Catalyst apni asal oxidation state mein wapas aata hai
Products alag (desorb) hote hain aur surface agle cycle ke liye tayyar
Misaal: nickel salts, Ni(0)/Ni(II), acetylene se acrylic acid
Misaal: Haber process mein solid iron se ammonia

blocks.prompt:
17 Why does a transition metal ion act as a Lewis acid and a ligand as a Lewis base in a complex?
(Complex mein transition metal ion Lewis acid aur ligand Lewis base kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Metal ion ke paas khaali, qabil-e-rasai d-orbitals hain jo electron pairs lete hain, is liye yeh Lewis acid (electron pair lene wala) hai. Ligand ke paas kam az kam aik lone pair hai jo woh deta hai, is liye Lewis base hai. Coordinate (dative) bond banta hai.

book_ref.quote: The energy of these empty d-orbitals is low enough (accessible) to participate in bond formation.

blocks.prompt:
18 Define a ligand. What is the origin of the word?
(Ligand ki taareef karein. Yeh lafz kahan se aaya?)
blocks.explanation: Ligand woh molecule ya ion (maslan H₂O, NH₃, Cl⁻) hai jis ke paas kam az kam aik lone pair ho aur jo markazi metal se coordinate (dative) bond banaye. Yeh lafz Latin 'ligare' se hai, yani 'baandhna'.

book_ref.quote: A ligand is a molecule or ion (for example, H₂O, NH₃ or Cl⁻) that possesses at least one lone pair of electrons

blocks.prompt:
19 Differentiate between anionic and neutral ligands with examples and naming.
(Anionic aur neutral ligands mein misaalon aur naamon ke saath farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Ligands ko un ke charge se baanta jata hai:

book_ref.quote: The negatively charged electron pair donor species are called anionic ligands.

rows: Manfi charge wale electron pair dene wale
Be-charge molecules jo electron pair dete hain
Sab se zyada paye jate hain
Aam hain, maslan aqua aur ammine complexes mein
Misaalein: Cl⁻, CN⁻, OH⁻, C₂O₄²⁻
Misaalein: H₂O, NH₃, CO
Naam aam taur par '-o' par: chloro, cyano
Naam wohi rehte hain, magar aqua (H₂O), ammine (NH₃), carbonyl (CO)

blocks.prompt:
20 What are cationic ligands? Give two examples with their names.
(Cationic ligands kya hain? Do misaalein naamon ke saath dein.)
blocks.explanation: Musbat charge wali species jo electron pair deti hain cationic ligands hain. Yeh kam milte hain aur naam aksar '-ium' par khatam hote hain, maslan NO⁺ (nitrosonium) aur NH₂–NH₃⁺ (hydrazinium).

book_ref.quote: They are rare and their names often ends at

blocks.prompt:
21 Differentiate between monodentate and bidentate ligands.
(Monodentate aur bidentate ligands mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq aik metal ion ko diye gaye electron pairs ki tadaad ka hai:

book_ref.quote: A monodentate ligand is a species that can donate only one pair of electrons

rows: Sirf aik electron pair deta hai
Do electron pairs deta hai
Aik donor atom dative bond banata hai
Do donor atoms do dative bonds banate hain
Misaalein: H₂O, NH₃, CO, Cl⁻, OH⁻, CN⁻
Misaalein: 1,2-diaminoethane (en), ethanedioate C₂O₄²⁻

blocks.prompt:
22 What is a polydentate ligand? Name the donor atoms of EDTA.
(Polydentate ligand kya hai? EDTA ke donor atoms ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Polydentate ligand aik metal atom ya ion se do se zyada dative bonds banata hai. EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetate) hexadentate hai: yeh chhe donor atoms, chaar oxygen aur do nitrogen, se judta hai.

book_ref.quote: A polydentate ligand is a general term used for any ligand that forms more than two dative bonds

blocks.prompt:
23 What is a coordination sphere? How is it written?
(Coordination sphere kya hai? Ise kaise likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh markazi metal atom ya ion aur us se seedha jure ligands hain. Yeh qareebi chemical mahaul batata hai aur aam taur par square brackets mein likha jata hai, maslan [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻.

book_ref.quote: A coordination sphere is the central metal atom or ion and the directly bonded ligands

blocks.prompt:
24 Find the charge on iron in the complex ion [Fe(C₂O₄)₃]³⁻.
(Complex ion [Fe(C₂O₄)₃]³⁻ mein iron ka charge maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Metal ka charge = sphere ka charge − ligands ka kul charge = (−3) − [3 × (−2)] = −3 + 6 = +3. Iron Fe³⁺ hai.

book_ref.quote: The charge on coordination sphere is the arithmetic sum of the charges of central metal atom or ion and ligands.

blocks.prompt:
25 Give the coordination numbers of the metal ions in [Co(en)₃]³⁺ and [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺.
([Co(en)₃]³⁺ aur [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺ mein metal ions ke coordination numbers batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Coordination number = metal se kul dative bonds. [Co(en)₃]³⁺: teen bidentate en, 3 × 2 = 6. [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺: do monodentate NH₃, yani 2.

book_ref.quote: The coordination number is the total number of dative bonds formed between ligands and the central metal atom or ion

blocks.text: 18.4 Predicting Formula and Charge of a Complex Ion

blocks.prompt:
26 Predict the formula and charge of the complex formed by (i) Cr³⁺ with six H₂O ligands, (ii) Ni²⁺ with four CN⁻ ligands.
(In se banne wale complex ka formula aur charge batayein: (i) Cr³⁺ aur chhe H₂O ligands, (ii) Ni²⁺ aur chaar CN⁻ ligands.)

book_ref.quote: The general structure of a complex ion is [M(L)ₓ]±ʸ.

blocks.prompt:
27 Why is [Ni(CO)₄] a neutral complex?
([Ni(CO)₄] neutral complex kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nickel 0 oxidation state mein hai aur CO (carbonyl) neutral ligand hai. Charge = (0) + 4 × (0) = 0, is liye complex par koi charge nahi.

book_ref.quote: Metal charge (0) + (Number of ligands × Ligand charge). A zero sum.

blocks.prompt:
28 Find the oxidation state of the metal in (i) [Cu(H₂O)₄(OH)₂] and (ii) [Co(NH₃)₆]²⁺.
(Metal ki oxidation state nikalein: (i) [Cu(H₂O)₄(OH)₂] aur (ii) [Co(NH₃)₆]²⁺.)

book_ref.quote: Where, M is the central metal ion, L is the ligand

blocks.prompt:
29 Describe the linear geometry of complexes with two examples.
(Complexes ki linear geometry do misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Linear complex mein do ligands markazi metal ion ke aamne saamne 180° par jure hote hain. Misaalein: [Ag(NH₃)₂]Cl aur K[Ag(CN)₂].

book_ref.quote: In this geometry, the two ligands are attached on opposite sides of the central metal ion at an angle of 180°.

blocks.prompt:
30 Describe square planar geometry. Which metal ions usually show it?
(Square planar geometry bayan karein. Aam taur par kaun se metal ions yeh dikhate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Metal ion aur chaar ligands aik plane mein square ke konon par hain, bond angle 90°. Yeh d⁸ ions jaise Ni²⁺ aur Pt²⁺ ki khaasiyat hai, maslan [Ni(CN)₄]²⁻ aur [Pt(NH₃)₄]²⁺.

book_ref.quote: In square planar shape, the central metal ion and the four ligands lie in the same plane

blocks.prompt:
31 How are the six ligands arranged in an octahedral complex? Give two examples.
(Octahedral complex mein chhe ligands kaise tarteeb mein hain? Do misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Chhe ligands x, y aur z axes par aate hain. Chaar 90° par square plane banate hain aur do plane ke upar neeche aapas mein 180° par hain. Misaalein: [Cr(NH₃)₆]³⁺ aur [Co(en)₃]³⁺; yeh sab se aam geometry hai.

book_ref.quote: Four ligands form a square plane with an angle of 90°

blocks.prompt:
32 What is meant by degenerate and non-degenerate d orbitals?
(Degenerate aur non-degenerate d orbitals ka kya matlab hai?)
blocks.explanation: Akele atom mein paanchon d orbitals ki energy barabar hoti hai: yeh degenerate hain. Complex mein ligands ka electric field inhein do mukhtalif energy groups mein baant deta hai: yeh non-degenerate ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: making them non-degenerate

blocks.prompt:
33 Why do the d orbitals split when ligands approach a metal ion? What does Δ represent?
(Ligands metal ion ke qareeb aayein to d orbitals kyun bat jate hain? Δ kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Qareeb aate ligands electric field banate hain jo paanch d orbitals ko do mukhtalif energy groups mein baant deta hai. Δ dono sets ki energy ka farq hai, yani splitting ki miqdaar.

book_ref.quote: The energy difference is related to the extent of splitting between the two sets of orbitals

blocks.prompt:
34 Compare d-orbital splitting in octahedral and tetrahedral complexes.
(Octahedral aur tetrahedral complexes mein d-orbital splitting ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono fields d orbitals ko ulti tarah baant'te hain:

book_ref.quote: The magnitude of splitting in tetrahedral complexes is smaller than that in octahedral complexes

rows: Chhe ligands, maslan [Ti(H₂O)₆]³⁺
Chaar ligands, maslan [CuCl₄]²⁻
Neeche: dxy, dxz, dyz (teen)
Neeche: dx²−y², dz² (do)
Upar: dx²−y², dz² (do)
Upar: dxy, dxz, dyz (teen)
Zyada splitting
Kam splitting

blocks.prompt:
35 Arrange the ligands of the chapter's series in order of decreasing ΔE. Which gives larger splitting, NH₃ or Cl⁻?
(Chapter ki series ke ligands ko ghatte ΔE ki tarteeb mein likhein. NH₃ aur Cl⁻ mein se kaun zyada splitting deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: CN⁻ > en > NH₃ > H₂O > OH⁻ > Cl⁻ > Br⁻ > I⁻. NH₃ Cl⁻ se pehle hai, is liye NH₃ zyada splitting karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The nature of the ligand affects the magnitude of the splitting, ΔE.

blocks.prompt:
36 How does a large ΔE give a complex a yellow colour?
(Bara ΔE complex ko peela rang kaise deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bare ΔE ke liye zyada frequency (chhoti wavelength) ki violet ya neeli roshni jazb hoti hai. Complementary peeli roshni wapas aati hai, is liye compound peela nazar aata hai.

book_ref.quote: that is in the region of violet or blue colour

blocks.prompt:
37 When does a compound appear black, white or coloured in white light?
(Safaid roshni mein compound kab kaala, kab safaid aur kab rangeen nazar aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kaala: saari safaid roshni jazb kar le. Safaid: saari roshni wapas kare ya guzar de. Rangeen: kuch roshni jazb kare aur baqi wapas kare; rang wapas aane wali roshni par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: Another option is that the compound may absorb some of the light and reflect the remaining part

blocks.prompt:
38 How is the colour of a complex related to the light it absorbs? Give an example.
(Complex ka rang jazb shuda roshni se kaise juda hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Nazar aane wala rang jazb shuda roshni ka complementary (ulta) rang hota hai. Maslan jo complex peeli roshni jazb kare woh violet nazar aata hai.

book_ref.quote: The colour we see is the opposite (complementary colour) to the colour

blocks.prompt:
39 A complex absorbs light of wavelength 450 nm. Find ΔE for one d-d transition and per mole (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, Nᴀ = 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹).
(Aik complex 450 nm wavelength ki roshni jazb karta hai. Aik d-d transition aur aik mole ke liye ΔE nikalein (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, Nᴀ = 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹).)

book_ref.quote: The energy required for a d-d transition, corresponds to a specific frequency

blocks.prompt:
40 A d-d transition absorbs light of wavelength 500 nm. Calculate the frequency of this light (c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹).
(Aik d-d transition 500 nm wavelength ki roshni jazb karta hai. Is roshni ki frequency nikalein (c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹).)

book_ref.quote: The electrons in a lower-energy d-orbital absorb light and are promoted (excited)

blocks.prompt:
41 When does a ligand exchange reaction take place, and what properties of the complex change?
(Ligand exchange reaction kab hota hai aur complex ki kaun si properties badalti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ligands tab badalte hain jab naya complex zyada stable ho. Is se complex ki properties jaise rang, structure aur reactivity badal jati hain.

book_ref.quote: If new complex to be formed is more stable than substitution of ligands occurs

blocks.prompt:
42 What does Cu²⁺(aq) actually represent? What colour does it give?
(Cu²⁺(aq) asal mein kya hai? Yeh kaun sa rang deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cu²⁺(aq) asal mein complex ion [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ hai. Yeh copper(II) salts jaise copper sulphate ke solution ko neela rang deta hai.

book_ref.quote: This ion gives blue colour to the solution of a copper(II) salt

blocks.prompt:
43 What is observed when sodium hydroxide is added to copper(II) sulphate solution? Write the equation.
(Copper(II) sulphate solution mein sodium hydroxide dalne par kya dekha jata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Halka neela precipitate banta hai kyun ke do paani ligands do OH⁻ ions se badalte hain:
[Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺(aq) + 2OH⁻(aq) → [Cu(H₂O)₄(OH)₂](s) + 2H₂O(l)

book_ref.quote: Two water ligands are replaced by two hydroxide ions in this reaction.

blocks.prompt:
44 Write the equation for the direct exchange of water ligands in [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ by ammonia. How is the product often written?
([Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ mein paani ligands ki ammonia se seedhi tabdeeli ki equation likhein. Product aksar kaise likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺(aq) + 4NH₃(aq) → [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺(aq) + 4H₂O(l). Chaar paani badalte hain; gehra neela product aam taur par [Cu(NH₃)₄]²⁺ likha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: For simplicity, [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺ is usually written as [Cu(NH₃)₄]²⁺.

blocks.prompt:
45 What is observed when NaOH solution is added to aqueous cobalt(II) ions? Write the equation.
(Aqueous cobalt(II) ions mein NaOH solution dalne par kya dekha jata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Gulabi solution se cobalt(II) hydroxide ka neela precipitate banta hai jo rakhne par gulabi ho sakta hai:
[Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺(aq) + 2OH⁻(aq) → [Co(H₂O)₄(OH)₂](s) + 2H₂O(l)

book_ref.quote: On adding sodium hydroxide solution, we see a blue precipitate of cobalt(II) hydroxide

blocks.prompt:
46 Write the equation for the direct exchange of water ligands of [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ by concentrated ammonia. State the colour change.
([Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ ke paani ligands ki concentrated ammonia se seedhi tabdeeli ki equation likhein. Rang ki tabdeeli batayein.)
blocks.explanation: [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺(aq) + 6NH₃(aq) → [Co(NH₃)₆]²⁺(aq) + 6H₂O(l). Gulabi solution peela ho jata hai (hexaamminecobalt(II)).

book_ref.quote: Water ligands in [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ can also be exchanged directly with ammonia ligands

blocks.prompt:
47 Why does the colour of a complex change in a ligand exchange reaction?
(Ligand exchange reaction mein complex ka rang kyun badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Naye ligands (maslan NH₃ ya Cl⁻) d-orbital splitting ΔE ki miqdaar badal dete hain. Mukhtalif ΔE ka matlab mukhtalif frequency ki roshni jazb hona, is liye rang badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: leading to a different absorbed frequency and a different observed colour

blocks.text: 18.8 Stability of Complexes and Stability Constant (Kstab)

blocks.prompt:
48 Write the Kstab expression for [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻ ⇌ [CuCl₄]²⁻ + 6H₂O. Why is water left out?
([Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻ ⇌ [CuCl₄]²⁻ + 6H₂O ke liye Kstab expression likhein. Paani kyun nikala jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kstab = [CuCl₄²⁻] ÷ ([Cu(H₂O)₆²⁺][Cl⁻]⁴). Paani solvent hai aur is ka concentration constant rehta hai, is liye nikal diya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: In aqueous solutions, water is the initial ligand.

blocks.prompt:
49 What do high and low values of log₁₀ Kstab show about a complex?
(log₁₀ Kstab ki zyada aur kam qeemat complex ke baare mein kya batati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada log₁₀ Kstab: complex zyada stable aur equilibrium bohat right par. Kam log₁₀ Kstab: complex kam stable aur ligands asaani se hat jate hain. Log scale bari qeematon ka muqabla asaan karta hai.

book_ref.quote: And lower the log₁₀ Kstab, the complex is less stable, and the ligands can be easily displaced.

blocks.prompt:
50 What is the chelating effect? Use Table 18.5 to illustrate it.
(Chelating effect kya hai? Table 18.5 se wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: Polydentate ligands wale complexes ke stability constants monodentate walon se zyada hote hain; yeh chelating effect hai. log₁₀ Kstab: [CuCl₄]²⁻ 5.6, ammonia complex 13.1, magar [Cu(EDTA)]²⁻ (hexadentate EDTA) 18.8.

book_ref.quote: The data shows that complexes with polydentate ligands have higher stability constant values

blocks.prompt:
51 Why does the yellow [CuCl₄]²⁻ solution turn blue when ammonia is added? Write the equation.
(Peela [CuCl₄]²⁻ solution ammonia dalne par neela kyun ho jata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ammonia complex (log₁₀ Kstab 13.1) chloride complex (5.6) se bohat zyada stable hai, is liye NH₃ Cl⁻ ko hata deti hai:
[CuCl₄]²⁻(aq) + 4NH₃(aq) + 2H₂O(l) → [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺(aq) + 4Cl⁻(aq)

book_ref.quote: A ligand with a higher Kstab can displace a ligand with a lower Kstab.

blocks.prompt:
52 At equilibrium, [Cu(H₂O)₆²⁺] = 1.0 × 10⁻⁵, [Cl⁻] = 0.20 and [CuCl₄²⁻] = 6.4 × 10⁻³ mol dm⁻³. Calculate Kstab and log₁₀ Kstab.
(Equilibrium par [Cu(H₂O)₆²⁺] = 1.0 × 10⁻⁵, [Cl⁻] = 0.20 aur [CuCl₄²⁻] = 6.4 × 10⁻³ mol dm⁻³ hain. Kstab aur log₁₀ Kstab nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Kstab = 6.4 × 10⁻³ ÷ (1.0 × 10⁻⁵ × 0.20⁴) = 6.4 × 10⁻³ ÷ 1.6 × 10⁻⁸ = 4.0 × 10⁵. log₁₀ Kstab = 5.6, jo Table 18.5 wali qeemat hai.

book_ref.quote: The stability constant (Kstab) is an equilibrium constant (Kc) for the formation of a complex ion.

blocks.prompt:
53 Using Table 18.5, how many times larger is Kstab of [Cu(EDTA)]²⁻ (log 18.8) than that of [CuCl₄]²⁻ (log 5.6)?
(Table 18.5 se batayein ke [Cu(EDTA)]²⁻ (log 18.8) ka Kstab [CuCl₄]²⁻ (log 5.6) se kitne guna bara hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ratio = 10^(18.8 − 5.6) = 10^13.2 ≈ 1.6 × 10¹³. Is liye EDTA copper(II) se chloride ko asaani se hata deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The stability constant values (log₁₀ Kstab) of some copper (II) complexes are given Table 18.5.

blocks.prompt:
54 Define stereoisomers and name their two types.

blocks.explanation: Stereoisomers ka chemical formula aur bonds aik jaise hote hain magar ligands ki space mein tarteeb mukhtalif hoti hai. Do qismein: geometrical (cis-trans) isomerism aur optical isomerism.

book_ref.quote: There are two types of stereoisomerism: geometrical isomerism and optical isomerism.

blocks.prompt:
55 Why is cisplatin polar while transplatin is nonpolar?
(Cisplatin polar aur transplatin nonpolar kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transplatin mein aik jaise ligands aamne saamne (180°) hain, bond dipoles ulti simt mein ho kar khatam ho jate hain: nonpolar. Cisplatin mein yeh saath saath (90°) hain, bond moments khatam nahi hote, dipole moment sifar nahi: polar.

book_ref.quote: In cisplatin, the similar individual bond moments do not cancel out

blocks.prompt:
58 Why does [Ni(en)₃]²⁺ show optical isomerism?
([Ni(en)₃]²⁺ optical isomerism kyun dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh teen bidentate en ligands wala octahedral complex hai. Is ki do shaklein aik doosre ki mirror images hain jo aik doosre par nahi baithtin (enantiomers). Yeh polarized light ka plane ulti simton mein ghumati hain.

book_ref.quote: The two isomers are optical isomers because the two different molecules are mirror images of each other

blocks.prompt:
59 How is the feasibility of a redox reaction of transition metal ions decided?
(Transition metal ions ke redox reaction ka feasible hona kaise tay hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Half-reactions ke standard electrode potentials ka muqabla karein: E°cell = E°reduction − E°oxidation. Zyada musbat E° wali species reduce hoti hai. E°cell musbat ho to reaction feasible hai.

book_ref.quote: Transition elements are notable for their ability to exist in multiple oxidation states.

blocks.prompt:
60 In the reaction of acidified MnO₄⁻ with C₂O₄²⁻, identify the oxidizing and reducing agents and calculate E°cell (E°: MnO₄⁻/Mn²⁺ = +1.52 V, 2CO₂/C₂O₄²⁻ = −0.49 V).
(Acidified MnO₄⁻ aur C₂O₄²⁻ ke reaction mein oxidizing aur reducing agents batayein aur E°cell nikalein (E°: MnO₄⁻/Mn²⁺ = +1.52 V, 2CO₂/C₂O₄²⁻ = −0.49 V).)
blocks.explanation: MnO₄⁻ (zyada musbat E°) Mn²⁺ mein reduce hota hai: oxidizing agent. C₂O₄²⁻ CO₂ mein oxidize hota hai: reducing agent. E°cell = 1.52 − (−0.49) = +2.01 V, reaction feasible hai.

book_ref.quote: The given reduction potential values indicate that Mn(VII) ion should be reduced to Mn(II)

blocks.prompt:
61 Write the balanced ionic equation for the oxidation of C₂O₄²⁻ by acidified MnO₄⁻. Why are the half-equations multiplied by 2 and 5?
(Acidified MnO₄⁻ se C₂O₄²⁻ ki oxidation ki balanced ionic equation likhein. Half-equations ko 2 aur 5 se kyun zarab dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: 2MnO₄⁻ + 16H⁺ + 5C₂O₄²⁻ → 2Mn²⁺ + 10CO₂ + 8H₂O. Khoye aur liye gaye electrons barabar hone chahiye: reduction half (5e⁻) × 2 aur oxidation half (2e⁻) × 5, dono mein 10 electrons.

book_ref.quote: Here, oxidation half equation is multiplied by 2 and reduction half equation by 5.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book mein multipliers ulte chhape hain. Sahi yeh hai: MnO₄⁻ wali half-equation × 2 aur C₂O₄²⁻ wali × 5, taake dono taraf 10 electrons hon.
